The Build — Fitzroy North 01

ACT 01The land

A flat, north-facing block in the inner north. Every Halden build starts with the block, not the brochure — soil, fall, light and the neighbours' gum trees all shape the plan.

Completed homes

Three of the twenty-seven.

Every Halden home is a one-off. These three sit within four streets of each other — drive past and you can read three different briefs in brick, timber and stone.

The Dusk House

A knockdown-rebuild on a 412 m² block. The clients asked for a house that disappears into the gum trees by day and glows like a lantern by night — blackened timber, a stone hearth wall, and every living room facing north.

How it works

Five steps, one builder.

01

Consult

We walk your block together and talk budget before drawings. Free, and no obligation to continue.

02

Concept plans with our architects, costed at every stage — never designed first and priced later.

03

04

A fixed-price contract and a weekly photo report — the five acts above, sent to your phone.

Questions

Before you ask.

How long does a Halden build take?

Eleven months on average, from slab to keys, for a two-storey home around 240 m². Single-storey homes usually land in eight to nine months. The contract carries a fixed completion date with liquidated damages — if we run late, it costs us, not you.

What does the estimator's figure include — and exclude?

It includes the full build: structure, services, fit-out and the finish level you selected. It excludes the land itself, council and permit fees (usually AUD 18,000–30,000 in Melbourne), and landscaping. Every Halden quote is itemised line by line, so the estimate and the contract can be compared directly.

Can I bring my own architect or plans?

Yes. Around a third of Halden homes start from an outside architect's plans. We cost them honestly at the Permit stage and flag anything that will be expensive to build before you are committed — no redesign fees, no pressure to switch to our team.

Do you build outside the inner north?

Our fourteen suburbs run from Fitzroy North to Coburg and out to Ivanhoe. Further afield we consider one build at a time — tell us the suburb in your enquiry and we will give you a straight answer within two business days.
